blocks.html: It is We Roll Up‘s policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect while operating our website. This Privacy Policy applies to We Roll Up (hereinafter, “us”, “we”, or “We Roll Up“). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting personally identifiable information you may provide us through the Website. We have adopted this privacy policy (“Privacy Policy”) to explain what information may be collected on our Website, how we use this information, and under what circumstances we may disclose the information to third parties. This Privacy Policy applies only to information we collect through the Website and does not apply to our collection of information from other sources.

blocks.html: Website Visitors
blocks.text: Website Visitors

blocks.html: Like most website operators, We Roll Up collects non-personally-identifying information of the sort that web browsers and servers typically make available, such as the browser type, language preference, referring site, and the date and time of each visitor request. We Roll Up‘s purpose in collecting non-personally identifying information is to better understand how We Roll Up‘s visitors use its website. From time to time, We Roll Up may release non-personally-identifying information in the aggregate, e.g., by publishing a report on trends in the usage of its website.

blocks.html: Advertisements
blocks.text: Advertisements

blocks.html: Ads appearing on our website may be delivered to users by advertising partners, who may set cookies. These cookies allow the ad server to recognize your computer each time they send you an online advertisement to compile information about you or others who use your computer. This information allows ad networks to, among other things, deliver targeted advertisements that they believe will be of most interest to you. This Privacy Policy covers the use of cookies by We Roll Up and does not cover the use of cookies by any advertisers.

blocks.html: We Roll Up uses Google AdWords for remarketing
blocks.text: We Roll Up uses Google AdWords for remarketing

blocks.html: We Roll Up uses the remarketing services to advertise on third party websites (including Google) to previous visitors to our site. It could mean that we advertise to previous visitors who haven’t completed a task on our site, for example using the contact form to make an enquiry. This could be in the form of an advertisement on the Google search results page, or a site in the Google Display Network. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on someone’s past visits. Of course, any data collected will be used in accordance with our own privacy policy and Google’s privacy policy.

blocks.html: Protection of Certain Personally-Identifying Information
blocks.text: Protection of Certain Personally-Identifying Information

blocks.html: We Roll Up discloses potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information only to those of its employees, contractors and affiliated organizations that (i) need to know that information in order to process it on We Roll Up‘s behalf or to provide services available at We Roll Up‘s website, and (ii) that have agreed not to disclose it to others. Some of those employees, contractors and affiliated organizations may be located outside of your home country; by using We Roll Up‘s website, you consent to the transfer of such information to them. We Roll Up will not rent or sell potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information to anyone. Other than to its employees, contractors and affiliated organizations, as described above, We Roll Up discloses potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information only in response to a subpoena, court order or other governmental request, or when We Roll Up believes in good faith that disclosure is reasonably necessary to protect the property or rights of We Roll Up, third parties or the public at large.

We primarily use our blog to communicate this type of information, so we expect to keep this type of email to a minimum. blocks.html: Cookies
blocks.text: Cookies

blocks.html: To enrich and perfect your online experience, We Roll Up uses “Cookies”, similar technologies and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising and store your preferences on your computer.
blocks.text: To enrich and perfect your online experience, We Roll Up uses “Cookies”, similar technologies and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising and store your preferences on your computer.

blocks.html: A cookie is a string of information that a website stores on a visitor’s computer, and that the visitor’s browser provides to the website each time the visitor returns. We Roll Up uses cookies to help We Roll Up identify and track visitors, their usage of http://We Roll Up, and their website access preferences. We Roll Up visitors who do not wish to have cookies placed on their computers should set their browsers to refuse cookies before using We Roll Up‘s websites, with the drawback that certain features of We Roll Up‘s websites may not function properly without the aid of cookies.
